tools.name: search_bots
tools.description: Search community Grok Bot templates by task, keyword, category or app (up to 20 results). Returns name, slug, directory page URL, x.ai share link, creator, a summary (at most 300 characters) and category. Listings are read from public share pages and are not tested. Cite the url field.

tools.name: get_bot
tools.description: One listing by slug: creator, share link, share-page description, tags, check dates and any editorial notes. Only public, live listings are available. Nothing beyond the creator's public share-page description is returned.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The eight directory categories and the tag collections, with live counts and page links. Also lists the app slugs accepted by search_bots.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the setup, pricing, workflow, safety and troubleshooting guides. Returns title, URL, description and last update date.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: One guide as plain text with its evidence label, update date and sources. Text is capped at about 12,000 characters; the URL has the full page.

tools.name: troubleshoot
tools.description: Describe a Grok Bot problem; get the 1–3 most relevant Fix problems guides with their first answer. Each match includes the guide URL, a short answer, the most relevant section and official sources. Community guidance, not official support.

tools.name: search
tools.description: ChatGPT connector search: ids, titles and URLs across Bots and guides. Pass an id to fetch for the full text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: ChatGPT connector fetch: the full text of one Bot or guide by id. Ids look like 'bot:<slug>' or 'guide:<slug>'.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_bots, search_guides, get_guide, troubleshoot, search · Public sink: search_bots, get_bot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_bots, search_guides, get_guide, troubleshoot, search · Public sink: search_bots, get_bot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
